dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave spline following the posterior margin, exhibiting a sharp inward curve from the sub-apex region to the basal transition.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphological classification with a narrow pixel radius relative to the total fin elevation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Extremely shallow convex slope extending anteriorly at a low gradient relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Highly elongated profile with a width-to-height ratio approximately measured at 3.8:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible triangular notch on the lower trailing edge; irregular serrated indentations along the anterior basal margin; light-colored linear scratching on the lateral surface near the trailing edge base.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive elongated basal hump preceding the primary vertical elevation of the dorsal fin.
